brand.purpose: Header name beside the 活俠 stamp.

title.purpose: Wiki h3/h4 sub-headings. h2 is text plus a 1px hairline.

body.purpose: Reading text, max 56rem column; tables and lists wider.

table.purpose: Lookup tables, plain and ruled, 1rem at 1.7.

label.purpose: Timeline month and group headings in muted ink.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Page article fades in with a 6px rise. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: draw
motion.purpose: Title brush rule revealed left to right by clip-path.

motion.name: spoiler
motion.purpose: Spoiler blur clears on hover, focus or tap.

components.name: Section Nav Link
components.description: Top section link; the current one is bold with a straight 2px seal underline.
components.html: 事件攻略人物秘笈
components.css: .ds-topnav { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem 1.25rem; font: 400 16px/1.8 'Noto Serif TC', serif; } .ds-topnav a { color: var(--m-fg, #2b333e); text-decoration: none; padding: 0.25rem 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-topnav a:hover { color: var(--m-accent, #861717); } .ds-topnav a[aria-current='page'] { font-weight: 600; border-bottom-color: var(--m-seal, #c1272d); }

components.name: Sidebar Link
components.description: Sidebar entry. Wash on hover, seal fill for the current page, muted when the entry is unwritten.
components.html:
1. 普通條目
  2. 目前頁面
  3. 尚未撰寫
components.css: .ds-side { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font: 400 16px/1.6 'Noto Serif TC', serif; } .ds-side a { display: block; padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem; color: var(--m-fg, #2b333e); text-decoration: none; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-side a:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--m-fg, #2b333e) 7%, rgb(var(--m-paper-rgb, 252 250 240))); } .ds-side a[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--m-seal, #c1272d); color: #fff; } .ds-side a.ds-missing { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--m-fg, #2b333e) 74%, rgb(var(--m-paper-rgb, 252 250 240))); } .ds-side a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--m-seal, #c1272d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Wiki Table
components.description: Plain ruled lookup table; 1rem text, wash header with a 2px ink bottom rule.
components.css: .ds-table { border-collapse: collapse; font: 400 1rem/1.7 'Noto Serif TC', serif; width: 100%; color: var(--m-fg, #2b333e); } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--m-fg, #2b333e) 22%, rgb(var(--m-paper-rgb, 252 250 240))); padding: 0.6rem 0.75rem; text-align: left; vertical-align: top; } .ds-table th { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--m-fg, #2b333e) 7%, rgb(var(--m-paper-rgb, 252 250 240))); font-weight: 600; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--m-fg, #2b333e); }

components.name: Entry List Item
components.description: Home entry: top hairline, bold link, muted description. No card box.
components.html: • 事件攻略依時間排列的事件
components.css: .ds-entries { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: 'Noto Serif TC', serif; } .ds-entries li { display: grid; gap: 0.1rem; padding: 0.5rem 0; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--m-fg, #2b333e) 22%, rgb(var(--m-paper-rgb, 252 250 240))); } .ds-entries a { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; color: var(--m-accent, #861717); } .ds-entries a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; } .ds-entries span { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--m-fg, #2b333e) 74%, rgb(var(--m-paper-rgb, 252 250 240))); font-size: 0.9375rem; }

components.name: Character Portrait
components.description: Seal on a dashed wash panel for a character without art; with art the image sits in a hairline frame. Floated right, 18rem.
components.css: .ds-portrait { width: 18rem; margin: 0; font-family: 'Noto Serif TC', serif; } .ds-portrait-seal { display: grid; place-items: center; height: 14rem; border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--m-fg, #2b333e) 22%, rgb(var(--m-paper-rgb, 252 250 240))); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--m-fg, #2b333e) 7%, rgb(var(--m-paper-rgb, 252 250 240))); } .ds-stamp { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 6rem; height: 6rem; background: var(--m-seal, #c1272d); color: #fff; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 900; } .ds-portrait figcaption { margin-top: 0.35rem; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--m-fg, #2b333e) 74%, rgb(var(--m-paper-rgb, 252 250 240))); font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Spoiler
components.description: Hidden wiki text, blurred until hover, focus or tap.
components.css: .ds-spoiler { filter: blur(5px); cursor: pointer; border-radius: 2px; transition: filter 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); font-family: 'Noto Serif TC', serif; } .ds-spoiler:hover, .ds-spoiler:focus-visible { filter: none; outline: none; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--m-fg, #2b333e) 7%, rgb(var(--m-paper-rgb, 252 250 240))); }

components.name: Bordered Tag
components.description: Small outlined tag in the link color, used beside sidebar entries.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; margin-left: 0.5rem; padding: 0 0.4rem; font: 400 0.75rem/1.6 'Noto Serif TC', serif; border: 1px solid currentColor; color: var(--m-accent, #861717); border-radius: 2px; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview: A reference opened on a second monitor mid-run, laid out like a desk with a scroll on it. Texture lives in seals and in two brush strokes (the header edge and the title rule); the reading text stays on calm paper. The visual vocabulary is the pinned library @shuimo-design/react (beta): a raw rice-paper ground, one cinnabar seal, a rare brush stroke. The project stylesheet only lays out and re-expresses the library's --m-* tokens; it adds no palette of its own. Ink effects are reserved for the header edge, the page title and stamps; tables and lists are never inked. Desktop only. Two themes share one structure: 宣紙 (light) and 墨夜 (dark).
keyCharacteristics: Rice-paper ground over the whole viewport, with the main column as the only scroller.
Straight 1px hairlines separate regions instead of boxes and cards; the brush stroke is kept for the header edge and the title rule.
One red voice: the seal. Everything else is ink on paper.
Noto Serif TC for everything, with weight 900 reserved for the title and brand.
Plain thin-ruled tables at 1rem text, wide enough to read, using the full column.
Character pages carry a floated portrait linked from the wiki, or a seal when there is none.
One authored motion: the page settles in and the title rule is drawn left to right.

rules.name: The One Seal Rule
rules.body: The seal red is the only chromatic color. It marks place (current page, brand stamp) and focus, never decoration or status.

rules.name: The Derived Neutrals Rule
rules.body: Muted, wash and line are always mixed from --m-fg and the paper token, never hard-coded, so both themes follow without a second palette.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Numbers that index (list numbers, months) use tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Pinned Root Rule
rules.body: The root font size is pinned to 16px because the library sets 14px, which would shrink every rem.

rules.name: The Rare Brush Rule
rules.body: The brush stroke (MBorder) appears at most twice per page: the header edge (.top-edge, stroke 3) and the title rule (.title-rule, stroke 4). Every other division is a straight 1px hairline in --line, a wash, or whitespace. Do not box regions with CSS borders; the table grid and the portrait frame are the only ruled structures.

dos: Do express new colors as mixes of --m-fg and the paper token, or as library --m-* tokens, so light and dark both follow.
Do keep seal red for place and focus: current marks, the brand stamp, selection and the focus ring.
Do separate regions with straight 1px --line hairlines; keep the brush stroke to the header edge and the title rule.
Do keep reading text on plain paper in Noto Serif TC at 1.8 line height inside the 56rem column, and let tables use the full column.
Do keep tables plain: hairline grid, wash header, no ink effects.
Do gate every animation behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
donts: Don't put ink or brush effects on dense tables or lists, or add brush strokes beyond the header edge and title rule.
Don't add phone-specific layout (drawer, scrolling nav, breakpoints); the site is desktop only.
Don't build a SaaS sidebar-and-cards dashboard: no card grids, no shadows, no pills.
Don't add a second accent hue or use red decoratively.
Don't hard-code light-only hex values in project CSS; they break 墨夜.
Don't show far-mountain imagery outside the home page.
